purpose: Authored decision guidance for choosing candidate stitches per design part, not executable stitch instructions or physical validation.
decisionOrder: Consider each part separately: flat panel, curved surface, tube, thick volume, narrow strip or open mesh.
Consider outline changes, bead orientation, desired flexibility, support and attachment access; shape alone does not determine the best stitch.
Compare at least two plausible techniques when there is a real alternative. A hybrid may use different stitches for different parts.
Check the compiler support below. A suitable technique is not necessarily implemented. Never relabel an existing route as another stitch.
Explain the chosen technique and the main compromise in scene notes. If an explicitly requested stitch is unavailable, say so and identify the actual draft technique.
Keep counts, geometry, thread paths, increases, decreases and joints algorithmic. A physical sample is still required.

stitches.label: Peyote
stitches.candidatesFor: Dense staggered surfaces; flat fabric, tubes and shaped rounded surfaces using the appropriate variant.
stitches.tradeoff: Choose flat, tubular or circular construction explicitly. Curvature requires a defined shaping schedule; round does not automatically mean peyote.
stitches.compilerSupport: Rounded hollow parts use the existing shaped peyote generator. Arbitrary flat peyote sheets and general tubular charts are not selectable generators yet.

stitches.label: Brick stitch
stitches.candidatesFor: Flat silhouettes with stepped or changing outlines, such as a petal, wing or small shaped panel.
stitches.tradeoff: Attachment uses thread bridges. Circular and tubular variants also exist; brick is not restricted to flat designs.
stitches.compilerSupport: Advisory only: no brick thread-bridge route generator. Current flat details use angle-weave panels; disclose that approximation rather than calling it brick.

stitches.label: Right-angle weave (RAW)
stitches.candidatesFor: Flexible connected bead-loop surfaces and open lattice-like panels.
stitches.tradeoff: Compare flexibility and gaps with a denser surface. RAW and cubic RAW are different constructions; rectangular appearance alone does not make a route RAW.
stitches.compilerSupport: Existing angle-weave panels use connected loops. The tube generator uses four-bead walls and five-bead ends; do not describe it as tubular peyote or uniformly four-bead RAW.

stitches.label: Cubic right-angle weave (CRAW)
stitches.candidatesFor: Chunky block-like volumes, frames and structural regions built from shared-edge cubes.
stitches.tradeoff: Cube geometry does not guarantee rigidity: tension and support still matter. Avoid choosing a thick lattice for a thin smooth surface.
stitches.compilerSupport: Available for non-flat box parts in parts mode, and the cubic lattice mode. Exact shared-edge counts and build order come from code.

stitches.label: Ladder stitch
stitches.candidatesFor: Short bead strips and foundations for brick or other stitches.
stitches.tradeoff: Treat it as a foundation or narrow construction when appropriate, not a general replacement for shaped surfaces.
stitches.compilerSupport: Advisory only: no ladder generator. Existing flexible return strands are not ladder stitch.

stitches.label: Herringbone
stitches.candidatesFor: Consider flat fabric or tubular ropes when paired angled beads and the desired drape suit the design.
stitches.tradeoff: Choose the flat or tubular variant and verify the tension and joining method for it.
stitches.compilerSupport: Advisory only: no herringbone route generator.

stitches.label: Netting
stitches.candidatesFor: Open mesh, lightweight coverings and wraps where visible gaps are intentional.
stitches.tradeoff: A mesh needs support and fit checks; it is not a closed dense shell.
stitches.compilerSupport: Advisory only: no netting route generator.

stitches.label: Square stitch
stitches.candidatesFor: Consider flat charted designs when an aligned bead grid is important.
stitches.tradeoff: Compare bead orientation and thread passes with staggered peyote or brick layouts.
stitches.compilerSupport: Advisory only: no square-stitch route generator.
